BMS-3780· PR #536

Replenishment Exception Codes

Jira: Review Story Epic BMS-5188 / REQ-261 · Spec B (SF-native) Data-ModelWMSWMS-UI labels: gulf · wms · phase-1-crawl · polished

Gives Gulf warehouse workers a structured way to log why a replenishment task can't be completed as assigned — a 7-code taxonomy (only OTHER needs a ≥10-char note), stamped with user/warehouse/shift/timestamp on a new audit child object. A completion gate blocks closing a task with unresolved exceptions unless a permission-gated Supervisor Override is logged, and a report type rolls exceptions up by code, shift, and warehouse. Offline sync, a drillable dashboard, and intercompany close-to-code notifications are explicitly descoped to follow-ups. View PR ↗ · BMS-3780 ↗

Implementation Narrative

What was built · file-by-file · key decisions · review status

What was built. This PR implements BMS-3780 end-to-end as a Salesforce-native feature (Spec B) across three tiers. Tier 0 adds the Replenishment_Exception__c audit child object and a warehouse-scoped Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt CMDT seeded with 7 codes. The WMS backend adds a resolver + a 413-line service (E_ReplenishmentExceptions) for log/get/resolve/override, and wires a completion gate into E_ReplenishmentTask.completeTask so a task can't close with unresolved exceptions absent a logged Supervisor Override. WMS-UI adds an inline log-exception panel + badges to the worker queue and an exception-history/resolve/override view to the task manager, through the WMS_UI_Wrappers facade. Reporting, a supervisor override custom permission, and an extended audit-log permission set round it out.

Acceptance Criteria (6 Gherkin scenarios)
Picker logs an exception code
Log Exception → structured picklist (7 codes); only OTHER needs a ≥10-char note; stamped with user, warehouse, shift, timestamp; task → 'Exception Logged', stays in queue.
Multiple exceptions on one task
A second code can be added without overwriting the first; both preserved as separate child records; task exception-count shows '2'; supervisor sees full history.
Close-to-code diversion flag
Selecting Close-to-Code Diversion flags the task for supervisor review; task does not auto-complete. (Intercompany notification descoped to follow-up.)
Supervisor summary by shift/warehouse
Report type gives counts by code, shift, warehouse. (Drillable dashboard LWC descoped to follow-up.)
Offline handheld sync
Offline exception syncs on reconnect with original timestamp; no duplicates. (Offline sync descoped to follow-up per epic plan.)
Completion blocked by unresolved exceptions
Cannot complete a task with unresolved exceptions; user gets Resolve-All or Supervisor Override (permission-gated, audited); once all resolved/overridden, task completes.

Key Decisions

  1. Spec B (Salesforce-native) over off-platform. The ticket offered two specs; the engineer chose the SF-native path — CMDT taxonomy + child audit object co-located with the task lifecycle and permission model, using the shipped warehouse-override CMDT pattern rather than a new off-platform module.
  2. Reused the established CMDT override pattern (Scan_Exception_Code / Pick_Reason_Code) — explicitly "not a fifth reason system," per the ticket's constraints.
  3. Append-only audit-log permission model. Worker perm set grants create/read/edit but no delete — exceptions are an immutable audit trail.
  4. Supervisor Override is permission-gated + audited via the new Override_Replenishment_Exception custom permission and Resolved_By__c/Resolution_Source__c, mirroring Override_Scan_Requirement.
  5. Deliberate descoping. Offline handheld sync, a custom drillable dashboard LWC, and intercompany close-to-code notifications are pushed to follow-ups per the epic plan — the report type covers the core "counts by code/shift/warehouse" AC without the dashboard.

One /code-review pass by alv-sanchez — 6 findings, all dispositioned:

BLOCKERREFUTEDFLS grant missing on Exception_Code__c / Replenishment_Task__c. Author re-verified against the live org: Salesforce rejects explicit FLS on these two fields (schema-required), so the grant is impossible — false positive, not a gap. WARNINGFIXEDResolve/override confirm buttons lacked a disabled binding. Added disabled={isBusy} to both + a Jest test. WARNINGFIXEDJira key embedded in shipped object <description>. Stripped from all four descriptions (object, CMDT, report type, custom permission). SUGGESTIONFIXEDexceptionSubmitDisabled ignored note-length. Now returns true when the required note is under the 10-char minimum, sharing the MIN_EXCEPTION_NOTE_LENGTH constant + Jest test. SUGGESTIONDOCUMENTEDZero-arg toDTO(task) hardcodes openExceptionCount = 0. Kept the overload; added a doc comment spelling out the invariant that both call sites are provably 0. SUGGESTIONDEFERRED4th near-verbatim copy of the warehouse-override algorithm. Extraction touches 3 other shipped, out-of-scope classes — filed as a follow-up rather than bundled here (a legitimate scope call; the private helpers aren't frozen signatures, so no urgency).

CI: Apex green (112 tests, 90.5–100% coverage), Jest green (1518/1518). The one hard Playwright failure — replenishment-exception-codes.spec.ts:190 — is the PR's own spec: the client-gate fix (WARNING #4) now disables the submit button the test still tries to click, so the spec needs updating to assert the disabled state. Not an infra flake — a test/behavior mismatch the PR introduced.

950+### [Test Isolation] Worker-queue "My Tasks" is NOT warehouse-scoped — never `.first()` a my-task-card
951+**Discovered**: 2026-07-13 **Ticket**: BMS-3780
952+**Pattern**: `E_ReplenishmentTask.getWorkerQueue`'s assigned-tasks clause is `(Assigned_Worker__c = :workerId AND Status__c IN ('Assigned','In Progress'))` with NO warehouse filter — only the unassigned-pool clause is warehouse-scoped. Selecting the seeded warehouse in `replenishmentWorkerQueue`'s picker still shows every stale Assigned/In-Progress task the CLI user has ever accumulated (leaked seeds, prior smoke tests). Anchor the card on the seed's timestamp-unique item name — `sfPage.getByTestId("my-task-card").filter({ hasText: seed.itemName })` — which stays visible in the card header through every inline-panel swap (exception form, completion form). And tear leaked tasks down in `afterAll`: every undeleted Assigned task pollutes all future runs on that org.
953+**Why**: `.first()` grabbed a stale In-Progress card from an earlier live smoke test (wrong item, "2 exceptions" badge) and four tests failed on assertions that were actually correct for the seeded task.
954+**Apply when**: Any spec driving `replenishmentWorkerQueue`'s My Tasks list (start/complete/log-exception flows).
955+
956+### [Component-Specific] Namespaced orgs break LWC reads of unprefixed CMDT custom fields (`ec.Requires_Note__c` → undefined)
957+**Discovered**: 2026-07-13 **Ticket**: BMS-3780
958+**Pattern**: When Apex returns CMDT records (e.g. `List<Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt>`) through `@AuraEnabled`, custom-field keys serialize WITH the namespace on a namespaced org: `ohfy__Requires_Note__c`, not `Requires_Note__c`. LWC JS reading `ec.Requires_Note__c` gets `undefined` there, so client-side gates keyed off such fields silently don't fire — the server-side guard catches it instead, surfacing as the generic error toast ("Something went wrong" + guard message) rather than the LWC's friendly warning toast ("Note required"). Standard fields (`DeveloperName`, `Label`, `MasterLabel`) are unprefixed in both org types and safe. Write toast assertions tolerant of both paths: `locator(".toastTitle, .toastMessage").filter({ hasText: /Note required|note of at least 10 characters/ }).first()`, then prove the block server-side (record count 0).
959+**Why**: The BMS-3780 OTHER-note test asserted the client toast title and failed on the namespaced `replinish` org — the exact same spec would pass on a non-namespaced scratch, making this an org-variant flake if asserted narrowly. (Also a latent product nit: raw CMDT DTOs crossing the Aura boundary should be mapped to namespace-free DTO fields.)
960+**Apply when**: Any LWC flow whose client-side validation reads a custom field off records returned raw from Apex (CMDTs especially), tested on a namespaced org.
961+
948962 ### [Selector Patterns] pricingManager row-action buttons need a cell click first
949963 **Discovered**: 2026-07-15 **Ticket**: BMS-5904
950964 **Pattern**: In `pricingManager`, the product-row action buttons (`pricing-row-schedule-btn`, `pricing-row-schedule-another-btn`, `pricing-add-price-btn`) only render after clicking the seeded price cell (`[data-warehouse="..."][data-price-code="..."]`) to retarget the primary editing context. Expanding to the product row alone is NOT enough. Mirror `openScheduleDrawer` — expand, click the cell, THEN look for the row-action button.

1+/**
2+ * @description Global DTO for a single Replenishment_Exception__c record (BMS-3780), carried
3+ * across the OHFY-WMS → OHFY-WMS-UI package boundary as an `@AuraEnabled`
4+ * return element for the worker exception-logging flow and the supervisor
5+ * resolution flow. Per ADR-0007 (Global DTO Pattern for Cross-Package LWC Access)
6+ * this class is `global` with `@AuraEnabled global { get; set; }` properties and a
7+ * single parameterless constructor. Factory logic lives in
8+ * E_ReplenishmentExceptions, not here.
9+ */
10+global with sharing class ReplenishmentExceptionDTO {
11+ @AuraEnabled
12+ global String id { get; set; }
13+ @AuraEnabled
14+ global String taskId { get; set; }
15+ @AuraEnabled
16+ global String taskName { get; set; }
17+ @AuraEnabled
18+ global String exceptionCode { get; set; }
19+ @AuraEnabled
20+ global String note { get; set; }
21+ @AuraEnabled
22+ global String loggedById { get; set; }
23+ @AuraEnabled
24+ global String loggedByName { get; set; }
25+ @AuraEnabled
26+ global String warehouseId { get; set; }
27+ @AuraEnabled
28+ global String warehouseName { get; set; }
29+ @AuraEnabled
30+ global String shift { get; set; }
31+ @AuraEnabled
32+ global Datetime loggedAt { get; set; }
33+ @AuraEnabled
34+ global Boolean isResolved { get; set; }
35+ @AuraEnabled
36+ global String resolvedById { get; set; }
37+ @AuraEnabled
38+ global String resolvedByName { get; set; }
39+ @AuraEnabled
40+ global Datetime resolvedAt { get; set; }
41+ @AuraEnabled
42+ global String resolutionNote { get; set; }
43+ @AuraEnabled
44+ global String resolutionSource { get; set; }
45+
46+ global ReplenishmentExceptionDTO() {
47+ this.id = null;
48+ this.taskId = null;
49+ this.taskName = null;
50+ this.exceptionCode = null;
51+ this.note = null;
52+ this.loggedById = null;
53+ this.loggedByName = null;
54+ this.warehouseId = null;
55+ this.warehouseName = null;
56+ this.shift = null;
57+ this.loggedAt = null;
58+ this.isResolved = false;
59+ this.resolvedById = null;
60+ this.resolvedByName = null;
61+ this.resolvedAt = null;
62+ this.resolutionNote = null;
63+ this.resolutionSource = null;
64+ }
65+}

1+/**
2+ * @description Test for ReplenishmentExceptionDTO — verifies the parameterless constructor
3+ * defaults and that every @AuraEnabled accessor round-trips (ADR-0007).
4+ */
5+@isTest
6+private class ReplenishmentExceptionDTO_T {
7+ @isTest
8+ static void constructorDefaultsAndAccessors() {
9+ ReplenishmentExceptionDTO dto = new ReplenishmentExceptionDTO();
10+ Assert.areEqual(false, dto.isResolved, 'isResolved should default to false');
11+ Assert.isNull(dto.id, 'id should default to null');
12+ Assert.isNull(dto.resolvedAt, 'resolvedAt should default to null');
13+
14+ dto.id = 'a0Z000000000001';
15+ dto.taskId = 'a0R000000000001';
16+ dto.taskName = 'RT-00000001';
17+ dto.exceptionCode = 'BLOCKED_LOCATION';
18+ dto.note = 'Bin is physically blocked by a pallet jack.';
19+ dto.loggedById = '005000000000001';
20+ dto.loggedByName = 'Worker A';
21+ dto.warehouseId = 'a0L000000000001';
22+ dto.warehouseName = 'Mobile AL';
23+ dto.shift = '2026-06-17-AM';
24+ dto.loggedAt = Datetime.newInstance(2026, 6, 17, 8, 0, 0);
25+ dto.isResolved = true;
26+ dto.resolvedById = '005000000000002';
27+ dto.resolvedByName = 'Supervisor B';
28+ dto.resolvedAt = Datetime.newInstance(2026, 6, 17, 9, 0, 0);
29+ dto.resolutionNote = 'Pallet jack cleared.';
30+ dto.resolutionSource = 'Resolved';
31+
32+ Assert.areEqual('RT-00000001', dto.taskName, 'taskName round-trips');
33+ Assert.areEqual('BLOCKED_LOCATION', dto.exceptionCode, 'exceptionCode round-trips');
34+ Assert.areEqual(
35+ 'Bin is physically blocked by a pallet jack.',
36+ dto.note,
37+ 'note round-trips'
38+ );
39+ Assert.areEqual('Worker A', dto.loggedByName, 'loggedByName round-trips');
40+ Assert.areEqual('Mobile AL', dto.warehouseName, 'warehouseName round-trips');
41+ Assert.areEqual('2026-06-17-AM', dto.shift, 'shift round-trips');
42+ Assert.areEqual(true, dto.isResolved, 'isResolved round-trips');
43+ Assert.areEqual('Supervisor B', dto.resolvedByName, 'resolvedByName round-trips');
44+ Assert.areEqual('Pallet jack cleared.', dto.resolutionNote, 'resolutionNote round-trips');
45+ Assert.areEqual('Resolved', dto.resolutionSource, 'resolutionSource round-trips');
46+ }
47+}

87+
88+ Test.startTest();
89+ List<Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt> codes = ReplenishmentTaskController.getExceptionCodes(
90+ warehouseId()
91+ );
92+ ReplenishmentExceptionDTO logged = ReplenishmentTaskController.logTaskException(
93+ task.Id,
94+ 'PRODUCT_DAMAGE',
95+ null
96+ );
97+ List<ReplenishmentExceptionDTO> exceptions = ReplenishmentTaskController.getTaskExceptions(
98+ task.Id
99+ );
100+ E_ReplenishmentExceptions.setOverrideBypassForTest(true);
101+ List<ReplenishmentExceptionDTO> resolved = ReplenishmentTaskController.resolveTaskExceptions(
102+ new List<Id>{ logged.id },
103+ null,
104+ 'Supervisor Override'
105+ );
106+ Test.stopTest();
107+
108+ Assert.isFalse(codes.isEmpty(), 'exception codes delegated');
109+ Assert.isNotNull(logged.id, 'exception logging delegated');
110+ Assert.areEqual(1, exceptions.size(), 'exception read delegated');
111+ Assert.isTrue(resolved[0].isResolved, 'exception resolution delegated');
112+ }
76113 }
OHFY-WMS/force-app/main/default/classes/executables/replenishment/E_ReplenishmentExceptionCode.cls+127-0

1+/**
2+ * @description Reads `Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt` for the worker completion LWC's
3+ * exception-taxonomy picker (BMS-3780). Mirrors E_ReplenishmentReasonCode /
4+ * E_ScanExceptionCode: per-warehouse records (Warehouse_Code__c matching the
5+ * worker's warehouse) override global records (Warehouse_Code__c = null) sharing
6+ * the same DeveloperName; records for a different warehouse and inactive records
7+ * are filtered out. Distinct from Replenishment_Reason_Code__mdt, which covers
8+ * short-completion variance reasons, not the "could not complete as assigned"
9+ * exception taxonomy.
10+ *
11+ * `@namespaceAccessible` so E_ReplenishmentExceptions (and, through
12+ * ReplenishmentTaskController / WMS_UI_Wrappers, the LWC) can delegate here per
13+ * the UI Wrapper Pattern.
14+ */
15+@namespaceAccessible
16+public with sharing class E_ReplenishmentExceptionCode {
17+ /**
18+ * @description Returns active `Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt` records, ordered by
19+ * Sort_Order__c ASC then DeveloperName ASC, with per-warehouse override
20+ * semantics described on the class docstring.
21+ * @param warehouseLocationId Optional Id of the worker's warehouse Location. When
22+ * non-null, the Location's `Warehouse__c` text value is preferred for overrides;
23+ * when null, only global records are returned.
24+ */
25+ @namespaceAccessible
26+ public static List<Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt> getActiveExceptionCodes(
27+ Id warehouseLocationId
28+ ) {
29+ String warehouseCode = resolveWarehouseCode(warehouseLocationId);
30+
31+ // SYSTEM_MODE: Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt is configuration data (rule 1 in docs/security/mode-selection.md)
32+ List<Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt> all = (List<Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt>) QueryService.newBuilder(
33+ new List<String>{
34+ 'MasterLabel',
35+ 'DeveloperName',
36+ 'Is_Active__c',
37+ 'Sort_Order__c',
38+ 'Warehouse_Code__c',
39+ 'Requires_Note__c'
40+ },
41+ 'Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt'
42+ )
43+ .filters(new List<String>{ 'Is_Active__c = TRUE' })
44+ .orderBy(new List<String>{ 'Sort_Order__c ASC NULLS LAST', 'DeveloperName ASC' })
45+ .build()
46+ .execute(new Map<String, Object>{}, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE);
47+
48+ return resolveOverrides(all, warehouseCode);
49+ }
50+
51+ /**
52+ * @description In-memory override resolution, split out so unit tests can inject
53+ * crafted CMDT lists (Apex cannot insert real CMDT records in tests).
54+ */
55+ @TestVisible
56+ private static List<Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt> resolveOverrides(
57+ List<Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt> all,
58+ String warehouseCode
59+ ) {
60+ Map<String, Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt> winnerByName = new Map<String, Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt>();
61+ for (Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt ec : all) {
62+ if (ec.Is_Active__c != true) {
63+ continue;
64+ }
65+ Boolean isGlobal = String.isBlank(ec.Warehouse_Code__c);
66+ Boolean matchesWarehouse =
67+ String.isNotBlank(warehouseCode) && ec.Warehouse_Code__c == warehouseCode;
68+ if (!isGlobal && !matchesWarehouse) {
69+ continue;
70+ }
71+ Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt incumbent = winnerByName.get(ec.DeveloperName);
72+ if (incumbent == null) {
73+ winnerByName.put(ec.DeveloperName, ec);
74+ continue;
75+ }
76+ if (matchesWarehouse && String.isBlank(incumbent.Warehouse_Code__c)) {
77+ winnerByName.put(ec.DeveloperName, ec);
78+ }
79+ }
80+ List<Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt> out = new List<Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt>(
81+ winnerByName.values()
82+ );
83+ out.sort(new BySortOrder());
84+ return out;
85+ }
86+
87+ private static String resolveWarehouseCode(Id locationId) {
88+ if (locationId == null) {
89+ return null;
90+ }
91+ try {
92+ List<Location__c> rows = (List<Location__c>) QueryService.newBuilder(
93+ new List<String>{ 'Warehouse__c' },
94+ 'Location__c'
95+ )
96+ .filters(new List<String>{ 'Id = :locationId' })
97+ .limitAmount(1)
98+ .build()
99+ .execute(new Map<String, Object>{ 'locationId' => locationId });
100+ return rows.isEmpty() ? null : rows[0].Warehouse__c;
101+ } catch (Exception e) {
102+ Logger.getInstance()
103+ .error('E_ReplenishmentExceptionCode.resolveWarehouseCode failed', e);
104+ Logger.getInstance().flush();
105+ return null;
106+ }
107+ }
108+
109+ private class BySortOrder implements Comparator<Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt> {
110+ public Integer compare(
111+ Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt a,
112+ Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt b
113+ ) {
114+ Decimal sa = a.Sort_Order__c == null ? Decimal.valueOf(999999) : a.Sort_Order__c;
115+ Decimal sb = b.Sort_Order__c == null ? Decimal.valueOf(999999) : b.Sort_Order__c;
116+ if (sa < sb) {
117+ return -1;
118+ }
119+ if (sa > sb) {
120+ return 1;
121+ }
122+ String na = a.DeveloperName == null ? '' : a.DeveloperName;
123+ String nb = b.DeveloperName == null ? '' : b.DeveloperName;
124+ return na.compareTo(nb);
125+ }
126+ }
127+}

OHFY-WMS/force-app/main/default/classes/executables/replenishment/E_ReplenishmentExceptions.cls+413-0
@@ -0,0 +1,413 @@
1+/**
2+ * @description Executable engine for the replenishment worker's exception-logging and
3+ * supervisor resolution flow (BMS-3780). A worker who cannot complete a task as assigned
4+ * logs a structured Replenishment_Exception__c against the task (validated against the
5+ * active Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt taxonomy, with a required 10+ character note
6+ * for codes flagged Requires_Note__c, and rejected outright once the task has reached a
7+ * terminal Status__c). A supervisor later clears the exception — either as genuinely
8+ * Resolved (requires a note) or via a logged Supervisor Override (note optional, gated
9+ * behind the Override_Replenishment_Exception custom permission) — which is the only path
10+ * past E_ReplenishmentTask.completeTask's unresolved-exception completion gate.
11+ *
12+ * `@namespaceAccessible` so ReplenishmentTaskController (and through it the
13+ * WMS_UI_Wrappers facade) can delegate here per the UI Wrapper Pattern, and so
14+ * E_ReplenishmentTask can call getUnresolvedCountByTask for its completion gate and DTO
15+ * open-exception-count field.
16+ */
17+@namespaceAccessible
18+public with sharing class E_ReplenishmentExceptions {
19+ @namespaceAccessible
20+ public class ReplenishmentExceptionException extends Exception {
21+ }
22+
23+ private static final String RESOLUTION_SOURCE_RESOLVED = 'Resolved';
24+ private static final String RESOLUTION_SOURCE_OVERRIDE = 'Supervisor Override';
25+ private static final Set<String> VALID_RESOLUTION_SOURCES = new Set<String>{
26+ RESOLUTION_SOURCE_RESOLVED,
27+ RESOLUTION_SOURCE_OVERRIDE
28+ };
29+ private static final Integer MIN_NOTE_LENGTH = 10;
30+ // Matches Note__c / Resolution_Note__c field length (BMS-3780 code review) — rejected here
31+ // with a clear message instead of letting an over-length note fall through to a raw
32+ // STRING_TOO_LONG DML exception.
33+ private static final Integer MAX_NOTE_LENGTH = 255;
34+
35+ // Custom permission gating the Supervisor Override resolution source (BMS-3780 code review).
36+ // Modeled directly on S_ScanEnforcement.OVERRIDE_PERMISSION / canOverride().
37+ private static final String OVERRIDE_PERMISSION = 'Override_Replenishment_Exception';
38+
39+ @TestVisible
40+ private static Boolean canOverrideForTest;
41+
42+ // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
43+ // Logging
44+ // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
45+
46+ /**
47+ * @description Logs a structured exception against a replenishment task: validates the task
48+ * exists, the exception code resolves to an active Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt for
49+ * the task's warehouse, and (when that code is flagged Requires_Note__c) that the note is
50+ * at least 10 characters after trimming. Stamps Logged_By__c / Logged_At__c plus
51+ * Warehouse__c / Shift__c copied from the task.
52+ * @param taskId The replenishment task the exception blocks.
53+ * @param exceptionCode DeveloperName of an active Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt.
54+ * @param note Worker free-text note; required (10+ chars) when the code requires one.
55+ * @return The newly logged exception as a ReplenishmentExceptionDTO.
56+ */
57+ @namespaceAccessible
58+ public static ReplenishmentExceptionDTO logException(
59+ Id taskId,
60+ String exceptionCode,
61+ String note
62+ ) {
63+ if (taskId == null) {
64+ throw new ReplenishmentExceptionException('A task id is required to log an exception.');
65+ }
66+ if (String.isBlank(exceptionCode)) {
67+ throw new ReplenishmentExceptionException('An exception code is required.');
68+ }
69+
70+ Replenishment_Task__c task = loadTask(taskId);
71+ if (task == null) {
72+ throw new ReplenishmentExceptionException('Replenishment task not found: ' + taskId);
73+ }
74+ if (E_ReplenishmentTask.isTerminalStatus(task.Status__c)) {
75+ throw new ReplenishmentExceptionException(
76+ 'Cannot log an exception against a ' + task.Status__c + ' task.'
77+ );
78+ }
79+
80+ Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt matchedCode = resolveActiveCode(
81+ exceptionCode,
82+ task.Warehouse__c
83+ );
84+ if (matchedCode == null) {
85+ throw new ReplenishmentExceptionException(
86+ 'Unknown or inactive exception code: ' + exceptionCode
87+ );
88+ }
89+
90+ String trimmedNote = note == null ? '' : note.trim();
91+ if (matchedCode.Requires_Note__c == true && trimmedNote.length() < MIN_NOTE_LENGTH) {
92+ throw new ReplenishmentExceptionException(
93+ 'A note of at least ' +
94+ MIN_NOTE_LENGTH +
95+ ' characters is required for exception code ' +
96+ exceptionCode +
97+ '.'
98+ );
99+ }
100+ if (trimmedNote.length() > MAX_NOTE_LENGTH) {
101+ throw new ReplenishmentExceptionException(
102+ 'A note cannot exceed ' + MAX_NOTE_LENGTH + ' characters.'
103+ );
104+ }
105+
106+ Datetime loggedAt = System.now();
107+ Replenishment_Exception__c record = new Replenishment_Exception__c(
108+ Replenishment_Task__c = taskId,
109+ Exception_Code__c = exceptionCode,
110+ Note__c = String.isBlank(trimmedNote) ? null : trimmedNote,
111+ Logged_By__c = UserInfo.getUserId(),
112+ Logged_At__c = loggedAt,
113+ Warehouse__c = task.Warehouse__c,
114+ Shift__c = task.Shift__c
115+ );
116+ DmlService.doInsert(new List<Replenishment_Exception__c>{ record }, true);
117+
118+ ReplenishmentExceptionDTO dto = new ReplenishmentExceptionDTO();
119+ dto.id = record.Id;
120+ dto.taskId = task.Id;
121+ dto.taskName = task.Name;
122+ dto.exceptionCode = exceptionCode;
123+ dto.note = record.Note__c;
124+ dto.loggedById = UserInfo.getUserId();
125+ dto.loggedByName = UserInfo.getName();
126+ dto.warehouseId = task.Warehouse__c;
127+ dto.warehouseName = task.Warehouse__r != null ? task.Warehouse__r.Name : null;
128+ dto.shift = task.Shift__c;
129+ dto.loggedAt = loggedAt;
130+ dto.isResolved = false;
131+ return dto;
132+ }
133+
134+ // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
135+ // Read model
136+ // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
137+
138+ /**
139+ * @description Returns every exception logged against a task, oldest first.
140+ */
141+ @namespaceAccessible
142+ public static List<ReplenishmentExceptionDTO> getExceptions(Id taskId) {
143+ List<Replenishment_Exception__c> records = (List<Replenishment_Exception__c>) QueryService.newBuilder(
144+ exceptionQueryFields(),
145+ 'Replenishment_Exception__c'
146+ )
147+ .filters(new List<String>{ 'Replenishment_Task__c = :taskId' })
148+ .orderBy(new List<String>{ 'Logged_At__c ASC' })
149+ .build()
150+ .execute(new Map<String, Object>{ 'taskId' => taskId });
151+
152+ return toDTOs(records);
153+ }
154+
155+ /**
156+ * @description Bulk-safe unresolved exception count per task. Feeds
157+ * ReplenishmentTaskDTO.openExceptionCount (board/queue reads) and
158+ * E_ReplenishmentTask's completion gate. Every requested task id is present in the
159+ * returned map (0 when it has no unresolved exceptions), so callers never need a
160+ * null-coalesce at the read site.
161+ */
162+ @namespaceAccessible
163+ public static Map<Id, Integer> getUnresolvedCountByTask(Set<Id> taskIds) {
164+ Map<Id, Integer> countByTask = new Map<Id, Integer>();
165+ if (taskIds == null || taskIds.isEmpty()) {
166+ return countByTask;
167+ }
168+ for (Id taskId : taskIds) {
169+ countByTask.put(taskId, 0);
170+ }
171+
172+ List<Replenishment_Exception__c> unresolved = (List<Replenishment_Exception__c>) QueryService.newBuilder(
173+ new List<String>{ 'Id', 'Replenishment_Task__c' },
174+ 'Replenishment_Exception__c'
175+ )
176+ .filters(
177+ new List<String>{ 'Replenishment_Task__c IN :taskIds', 'Is_Resolved__c = FALSE' }
178+ )
179+ .build()
180+ .execute(new Map<String, Object>{ 'taskIds' => taskIds });
181+
182+ for (Replenishment_Exception__c rec : unresolved) {
183+ Integer running = countByTask.get(rec.Replenishment_Task__c);
184+ countByTask.put(rec.Replenishment_Task__c, (running == null ? 0 : running) + 1);
185+ }
186+ return countByTask;
187+ }
188+
189+ // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
190+ // Resolution
191+ // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
192+
193+ /**
194+ * @description Resolves (or supervisor-overrides) one or more logged exceptions, unblocking
195+ * E_ReplenishmentTask.completeTask's completion gate. "Resolved" requires a non-blank
196+ * resolutionNote; "Supervisor Override" does not, but requires the running user hold the
197+ * Override_Replenishment_Exception custom permission (BMS-3780 code review) — otherwise
198+ * this throws before touching any record. Throws if any id is unknown or already
199+ * resolved — a deterministic all-or-nothing call, never a silent partial skip.
200+ * @param exceptionIds Ids of Replenishment_Exception__c records to resolve.
201+ * @param resolutionNote Free-text note; required when resolutionSource is "Resolved".
202+ * @param resolutionSource "Resolved" or "Supervisor Override".
203+ * @return The updated exceptions as ReplenishmentExceptionDTOs.
204+ */
205+ @namespaceAccessible
206+ public static List<ReplenishmentExceptionDTO> resolveExceptions(
207+ List<Id> exceptionIds,
208+ String resolutionNote,
209+ String resolutionSource
210+ ) {
211+ if (exceptionIds == null || exceptionIds.isEmpty()) {
212+ throw new ReplenishmentExceptionException(
213+ 'At least one exception id is required to resolve.'
214+ );
215+ }
216+ if (!VALID_RESOLUTION_SOURCES.contains(resolutionSource)) {
217+ throw new ReplenishmentExceptionException(
218+ 'Resolution source must be "Resolved" or "Supervisor Override".'
219+ );
220+ }
221+ if (resolutionSource == RESOLUTION_SOURCE_OVERRIDE && !canOverride()) {
222+ throw new ReplenishmentExceptionException(
223+ 'Supervisor Override requires the Override Replenishment Exception permission.'
224+ );
225+ }
226+ if (resolutionSource == RESOLUTION_SOURCE_RESOLVED && String.isBlank(resolutionNote)) {
227+ throw new ReplenishmentExceptionException(
228+ 'A resolution note is required when resolving without a supervisor override.'
229+ );
230+ }
231+ if (resolutionNote != null && resolutionNote.length() > MAX_NOTE_LENGTH) {
232+ throw new ReplenishmentExceptionException(
233+ 'A resolution note cannot exceed ' + MAX_NOTE_LENGTH + ' characters.'
234+ );
235+ }
236+
237+ List<Replenishment_Exception__c> records = (List<Replenishment_Exception__c>) QueryService.newBuilder(
238+ exceptionQueryFields(),
239+ 'Replenishment_Exception__c'
240+ )
241+ .filters(new List<String>{ 'Id IN :exceptionIds' })
242+ .build()
243+ .execute(new Map<String, Object>{ 'exceptionIds' => exceptionIds });
244+
245+ Map<Id, Replenishment_Exception__c> byId = new Map<Id, Replenishment_Exception__c>();
246+ for (Replenishment_Exception__c rec : records) {
247+ byId.put(rec.Id, rec);
248+ }
249+ List<String> missing = new List<String>();
250+ for (Id exceptionId : exceptionIds) {
251+ if (!byId.containsKey(exceptionId)) {
252+ missing.add(String.valueOf(exceptionId));
253+ }
254+ }
255+ if (!missing.isEmpty()) {
256+ throw new ReplenishmentExceptionException(
257+ 'Replenishment exception(s) not found: ' + String.join(missing, ', ')
258+ );
259+ }
260+
261+ List<String> alreadyResolved = new List<String>();
262+ for (Id exceptionId : exceptionIds) {
263+ if (byId.get(exceptionId).Is_Resolved__c == true) {
264+ alreadyResolved.add(String.valueOf(exceptionId));
265+ }
266+ }
267+ if (!alreadyResolved.isEmpty()) {
268+ throw new ReplenishmentExceptionException(
269+ 'Replenishment exception(s) already resolved: ' + String.join(alreadyResolved, ', ')
270+ );
271+ }
272+
273+ Datetime resolvedAt = System.now();
274+ Id resolvedById = UserInfo.getUserId();
275+ List<Replenishment_Exception__c> toUpdate = new List<Replenishment_Exception__c>();
276+ for (Id exceptionId : exceptionIds) {
277+ Replenishment_Exception__c rec = byId.get(exceptionId);
278+ rec.Is_Resolved__c = true;
279+ rec.Resolved_By__c = resolvedById;
280+ rec.Resolved_At__c = resolvedAt;
281+ rec.Resolution_Note__c = resolutionNote;
282+ rec.Resolution_Source__c = resolutionSource;
283+ toUpdate.add(rec);
284+ }
285+ DmlService.doUpdate(toUpdate, true);
286+
287+ return toDTOs(toUpdate);
288+ }
289+
290+ // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
291+ // Helpers
292+ // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
293+
294+ /**
295+ * @description True when the running user holds the Override_Replenishment_Exception custom
296+ * permission and may resolve an exception via Supervisor Override without a resolution
297+ * note. Modeled directly on S_ScanEnforcement.canOverride().
298+ */
299+ private static Boolean canOverride() {
300+ if (canOverrideForTest != null) {
301+ return canOverrideForTest;
302+ }
303+ return FeatureManagement.checkPermission(OVERRIDE_PERMISSION);
304+ }
305+
306+ /**
307+ * @description Test-only hook that forces canOverride()'s result without requiring the
308+ * running test user to actually hold Override_Replenishment_Exception. Exposed as a
309+ * `@namespaceAccessible` setter (guarded by Test.isRunningTest()) rather than leaving
310+ * canOverrideForTest as a bare `@TestVisible private` field, so a cross-package test
311+ * (e.g. WMS_UI_Wrappers_T in OHFY-WMS-UI) can call it — a same-package-only
312+ * `@TestVisible` field passes per-PR CI but fails `sf package version create` (cross-
313+ * package @TestVisible antipattern).
314+ * @param value True/false to force canOverride()'s result; null to clear the override and
315+ * fall back to the real FeatureManagement.checkPermission check.
316+ */
317+ @namespaceAccessible
318+ public static void setOverrideBypassForTest(Boolean value) {
319+ if (!Test.isRunningTest()) {
320+ return;
321+ }
322+ canOverrideForTest = value;
323+ }
324+
325+ private static Replenishment_Task__c loadTask(Id taskId) {
326+ List<Replenishment_Task__c> tasks = (List<Replenishment_Task__c>) QueryService.newBuilder(
327+ new List<String>{
328+ 'Id',
329+ 'Name',
330+ 'Status__c',
331+ 'Warehouse__c',
332+ 'Warehouse__r.Name',
333+ 'Shift__c'
334+ },
335+ 'Replenishment_Task__c'
336+ )
337+ .filters(new List<String>{ 'Id = :taskId' })
338+ .limitAmount(1)
339+ .build()
340+ .execute(new Map<String, Object>{ 'taskId' => taskId });
341+ return tasks.isEmpty() ? null : tasks[0];
342+ }
343+
344+ private static Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt resolveActiveCode(
345+ String exceptionCode,
346+ Id warehouseId
347+ ) {
348+ for (
349+ Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt code : E_ReplenishmentExceptionCode.getActiveExceptionCodes(
350+ warehouseId
351+ )
352+ ) {
353+ if (code.DeveloperName == exceptionCode) {
354+ return code;
355+ }
356+ }
357+ return null;
358+ }
359+
360+ private static List<String> exceptionQueryFields() {
361+ return new List<String>{
362+ 'Id',
363+ 'Replenishment_Task__c',
364+ 'Replenishment_Task__r.Name',
365+ 'Exception_Code__c',
366+ 'Note__c',
367+ 'Logged_By__c',
368+ 'Logged_By__r.Name',
369+ 'Warehouse__c',
370+ 'Warehouse__r.Name',
371+ 'Shift__c',
372+ 'Logged_At__c',
373+ 'Is_Resolved__c',
374+ 'Resolved_By__c',
375+ 'Resolved_By__r.Name',
376+ 'Resolved_At__c',
377+ 'Resolution_Note__c',
378+ 'Resolution_Source__c'
379+ };
380+ }
381+
382+ private static List<ReplenishmentExceptionDTO> toDTOs(
383+ List<Replenishment_Exception__c> records
384+ ) {
385+ List<ReplenishmentExceptionDTO> dtos = new List<ReplenishmentExceptionDTO>();
386+ for (Replenishment_Exception__c rec : records) {
387+ dtos.add(toDTO(rec));
388+ }
389+ return dtos;
390+ }
391+
392+ private static ReplenishmentExceptionDTO toDTO(Replenishment_Exception__c rec) {
393+ ReplenishmentExceptionDTO dto = new ReplenishmentExceptionDTO();
394+ dto.id = rec.Id;
395+ dto.taskId = rec.Replenishment_Task__c;
396+ dto.taskName = rec.Replenishment_Task__r != null ? rec.Replenishment_Task__r.Name : null;
397+ dto.exceptionCode = rec.Exception_Code__c;
398+ dto.note = rec.Note__c;
399+ dto.loggedById = rec.Logged_By__c;
400+ dto.loggedByName = rec.Logged_By__r != null ? rec.Logged_By__r.Name : null;
401+ dto.warehouseId = rec.Warehouse__c;
402+ dto.warehouseName = rec.Warehouse__r != null ? rec.Warehouse__r.Name : null;
403+ dto.shift = rec.Shift__c;
404+ dto.loggedAt = rec.Logged_At__c;
405+ dto.isResolved = rec.Is_Resolved__c == true;
406+ dto.resolvedById = rec.Resolved_By__c;
407+ dto.resolvedByName = rec.Resolved_By__r != null ? rec.Resolved_By__r.Name : null;
408+ dto.resolvedAt = rec.Resolved_At__c;
409+ dto.resolutionNote = rec.Resolution_Note__c;
410+ dto.resolutionSource = rec.Resolution_Source__c;
411+ return dto;
412+ }
413+}
OHFY-WMS/force-app/main/default/classes/executables/replenishment/E_ReplenishmentExceptions.cls-meta.xml+5-0
@@ -0,0 +1,5 @@

1+/**
2+ * @description Test for E_ReplenishmentExceptionCode. Exercises the in-memory override
3+ * resolution (global vs per-warehouse, inactive + foreign-warehouse filtering,
4+ * sort) through the @TestVisible resolveOverrides seam — Apex cannot insert
5+ * CustomMetadataType records — plus getActiveExceptionCodes against the deployed
6+ * seeds (BLOCKED_LOCATION, INVENTORY_MISMATCH, EQUIPMENT_CONSTRAINT,
7+ * CLOSE_TO_CODE_DIVERSION, PRODUCT_DAMAGE, LOCATION_EMPTY, OTHER).
8+ */
9+@isTest
10+private class E_ReplenishmentExceptionCode_T {
11+ private static Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt ec(
12+ String dev,
13+ String label,
14+ Boolean active,
15+ Decimal sortOrder,
16+ String warehouseCode,
17+ Boolean requiresNote
18+ ) {
19+ return new Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt(
20+ DeveloperName = dev,
21+ MasterLabel = label,
22+ Is_Active__c = active,
23+ Sort_Order__c = sortOrder,
24+ Warehouse_Code__c = warehouseCode,
25+ Requires_Note__c = requiresNote
26+ );
27+ }
28+
29+ @isTest
30+ static void resolveOverrides_perWarehouseBeatsGlobal_filtersInactiveAndForeign() {
31+ List<Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt> all = new List<Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt>{
32+ ec('BLOCKED_LOCATION', 'Blocked Location (Global)', true, 10, null, false),
33+ ec('BLOCKED_LOCATION', 'Blocked Location (HSV)', true, 10, 'HSV', false),
34+ ec('PRODUCT_DAMAGE', 'Product Damage', true, 20, null, false),
35+ ec('INACTIVE_ONE', 'Inactive', false, 5, null, false),
36+ ec('FOREIGN', 'Foreign Warehouse', true, 1, 'MOB', false)
37+ };
38+
39+ Test.startTest();
40+ List<Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt> result = E_ReplenishmentExceptionCode.resolveOverrides(
41+ all,
42+ 'HSV'
43+ );
44+ Test.stopTest();
45+
46+ Map<String, Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt> byDev = new Map<String, Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt>();
47+ for (Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt r : result) {
48+ byDev.put(r.DeveloperName, r);
49+ }
50+ Assert.isFalse(byDev.containsKey('INACTIVE_ONE'), 'Inactive records are filtered out');
51+ Assert.isFalse(byDev.containsKey('FOREIGN'), 'Other-warehouse records are filtered out');
52+ Assert.areEqual(
53+ 'Blocked Location (HSV)',
54+ byDev.get('BLOCKED_LOCATION').MasterLabel,
55+ 'Per-warehouse record overrides the global with the same DeveloperName'
56+ );
57+ Assert.isTrue(byDev.containsKey('PRODUCT_DAMAGE'), 'Global-only record is retained');
58+ // Sorted by Sort_Order ascending: BLOCKED_LOCATION (10) before PRODUCT_DAMAGE (20).
59+ Assert.areEqual(
60+ 'BLOCKED_LOCATION',
61+ result[0].DeveloperName,
62+ 'Sorted by Sort_Order ascending'
63+ );
64+ }
65+
66+ @isTest
67+ static void resolveOverrides_globalOnlyWhenNoWarehouse() {
68+ List<Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt> all = new List<Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt>{
69+ ec('BLOCKED_LOCATION', 'Global', true, 10, null, false),
70+ ec('BLOCKED_LOCATION', 'HSV only', true, 10, 'HSV', false)
71+ };
72+
73+ List<Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt> result = E_ReplenishmentExceptionCode.resolveOverrides(
74+ all,
75+ null
76+ );
77+
78+ Assert.areEqual(1, result.size(), 'Only the global record survives when no warehouse code');
79+ Assert.areEqual('Global', result[0].MasterLabel, 'Global record is the survivor');
80+ }
81+
82+ @isTest
83+ static void resolveOverrides_tieBreaksByDeveloperName() {
84+ List<Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt> all = new List<Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt>{
85+ ec('ZEBRA', 'Z', true, 10, null, false),
86+ ec('ALPHA', 'A', true, 10, null, false)
87+ };
88+
89+ List<Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt> result = E_ReplenishmentExceptionCode.resolveOverrides(
90+ all,
91+ null
92+ );
93+
94+ Assert.areEqual(2, result.size(), 'Both global records survive');
95+ Assert.areEqual(
96+ 'ALPHA',
97+ result[0].DeveloperName,
98+ 'Equal Sort_Order ties break by DeveloperName ascending'
99+ );
100+ }
101+
102+ @isTest
103+ static void resolveOverrides_carriesRequiresNoteFlag() {
104+ List<Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt> all = new List<Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt>{
105+ ec('OTHER', 'Other', true, 70, null, true)
106+ };
107+
108+ List<Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt> result = E_ReplenishmentExceptionCode.resolveOverrides(
109+ all,
110+ null
111+ );
112+
113+ Assert.areEqual(1, result.size(), 'Global-only record survives');
114+ Assert.isTrue(result[0].Requires_Note__c, 'Requires_Note__c is carried through untouched');
115+ }
116+
117+ @isTest
118+ static void getActiveExceptionCodes_global_and_warehouseScoped() {
119+ AccessLevelResolver.setBypassOverrideForTest(true);
120+ Location__c warehouse = new Location__c(
121+ Name = 'Montgomery AL',
122+ Type__c = 'Warehouse',
123+ Is_Active__c = true
124+ );
125+ insert warehouse;
126+
127+ Test.startTest();
128+ // The package ships seven active global seeds (BLOCKED_LOCATION, INVENTORY_MISMATCH,
129+ // EQUIPMENT_CONSTRAINT, CLOSE_TO_CODE_DIVERSION, PRODUCT_DAMAGE, LOCATION_EMPTY, OTHER).
130+ List<Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt> globalCodes = E_ReplenishmentExceptionCode.getActiveExceptionCodes(
131+ null
132+ );
133+ // Warehouse-scoped path exercises resolveWarehouseCode (Location.Warehouse__c lookup).
134+ List<Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt> scopedCodes = E_ReplenishmentExceptionCode.getActiveExceptionCodes(
135+ warehouse.Id
136+ );
137+ Test.stopTest();
138+
139+ Assert.isFalse(globalCodes.isEmpty(), 'Active seed exception codes should be returned');
140+ Assert.isFalse(
141+ scopedCodes.isEmpty(),
142+ 'Warehouse-scoped lookup still returns the global seeds'
143+ );
144+ }
145+}

1+/**
2+ * @description Test for E_ReplenishmentExceptions (BMS-3780): logging an exception against a
3+ * task (validated against the active Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt taxonomy, with a
4+ * required 10+ character note for codes flagged Requires_Note__c — OTHER, per the deployed
5+ * seeds), the chronological read model, bulk unresolved-count reads, and supervisor
6+ * resolution (both "Resolved" and "Supervisor Override" sources).
7+ */
8+@isTest
9+private class E_ReplenishmentExceptions_T {
10+ private static final String SHIFT = '2026-06-17-AM';
11+
12+ @TestSetup
13+ static void makeData() {
14+ insert new Location__c(Name = 'Prattville AL', Type__c = 'Warehouse', Is_Active__c = true);
15+ }
16+
17+ private static Id warehouseId() {
18+ return [SELECT Id FROM Location__c WHERE Name = 'Prattville AL' LIMIT 1].Id;
19+ }
20+
21+ private static Id makeTask(String status) {
22+ Replenishment_Task__c task = new Replenishment_Task__c(
23+ Warehouse__c = warehouseId(),
24+ Status__c = status,
25+ Cases_Requested__c = 5,
26+ Shift__c = SHIFT
27+ );
28+ insert task;
29+ return task.Id;
30+ }
31+
32+ @isTest
33+ static void logException_happyPath_stampsWarehouseAndShiftFromTask() {
34+ AccessLevelResolver.setBypassOverrideForTest(true);
35+ Id taskId = makeTask('Assigned');
36+
37+ Test.startTest();
38+ ReplenishmentExceptionDTO dto = E_ReplenishmentExceptions.logException(
39+ taskId,
40+ 'BLOCKED_LOCATION',
41+ 'Pallet jack is blocking the bin front.'
42+ );
43+ Test.stopTest();
44+
45+ Assert.isNotNull(dto.id, 'Inserted record id is returned');
46+ Assert.areEqual('BLOCKED_LOCATION', dto.exceptionCode, 'exceptionCode carried through');
47+ Assert.areEqual(false, dto.isResolved, 'Newly logged exception is unresolved');
48+ Assert.areEqual(SHIFT, dto.shift, 'Shift stamped from the task');
49+ Assert.areEqual(warehouseId(), dto.warehouseId, 'Warehouse stamped from the task');
50+
51+ Replenishment_Exception__c stored = [
52+ SELECT Warehouse__c, Shift__c, Logged_By__c, Is_Resolved__c
53+ FROM Replenishment_Exception__c
54+ WHERE Id = :dto.id
55+ ];
56+ Assert.areEqual(warehouseId(), stored.Warehouse__c, 'Stored warehouse matches task');
57+ Assert.areEqual(SHIFT, stored.Shift__c, 'Stored shift matches task');
58+ Assert.areEqual(UserInfo.getUserId(), stored.Logged_By__c, 'Logged by the running user');
59+ Assert.isFalse(stored.Is_Resolved__c, 'Stored record starts unresolved');
60+ }
61+

130+ @isTest
131+ static void getExceptions_returnsChronologicalOrder() {
132+ AccessLevelResolver.setBypassOverrideForTest(true);
133+ Id taskId = makeTask('Assigned');
134+
135+ E_ReplenishmentExceptions.logException(taskId, 'PRODUCT_DAMAGE', null);
136+ E_ReplenishmentExceptions.logException(taskId, 'LOCATION_EMPTY', null);
137+
138+ // Force a deterministic ordering independent of clock resolution.
139+ List<Replenishment_Exception__c> stored = [
140+ SELECT Id, Exception_Code__c, Logged_At__c
141+ FROM Replenishment_Exception__c
142+ WHERE Replenishment_Task__c = :taskId
143+ ORDER BY CreatedDate ASC
144+ ];
145+ stored[0].Logged_At__c = Datetime.now().addMinutes(-10);
146+ stored[1].Logged_At__c = Datetime.now();
147+ update stored;
148+
149+ Test.startTest();
150+ List<ReplenishmentExceptionDTO> result = E_ReplenishmentExceptions.getExceptions(taskId);
151+ Test.stopTest();
152+
153+ Assert.areEqual(2, result.size(), 'Both exceptions are returned');
154+ Assert.areEqual(
155+ stored[0].Exception_Code__c,
156+ result[0].exceptionCode,
157+ 'Earliest Logged_At__c is first'
158+ );
159+ Assert.areEqual(
160+ stored[1].Exception_Code__c,
161+ result[1].exceptionCode,
162+ 'Latest Logged_At__c is last'
163+ );
164+ }

@@ -0,0 +1,7 @@
1+## Replenishment Exception Codes
2+
3+Warehouse workers can now log a structured reason when a replenishment task stalls — no more guessing why replenishment ran late. From the Replenishment Worker Queue, a worker facing a blocked task clicks **Log Exception**, picks a code (Blocked Location, Inventory Mismatch, Equipment Constraint, Close-to-Code Diversion, Product Damage, Location Empty, or Other), and adds a note. The exception is stamped with the worker, warehouse, shift, and timestamp automatically.
4+
5+A task with unresolved exceptions can't be marked complete — the worker sees exactly how many exceptions still need attention. Supervisors review the full exception history on the Replenishment Tasks board and either **Resolve** a task (with a resolution note) or, when warranted, **Override** it. Every exception feeds a new **Replenishment Exceptions** report type; the supervisor-facing rollup report by code, shift, and warehouse is tracked as a follow-on under the Reporting epic (BMS-5906).
6+
7+**Admins must:** assign the **Replenishment Board Access** permission set to workers and supervisors (grants the new `Replenishment_Exception__c` object), and grant the **Override Replenishment Exception** custom permission only to supervisors who should be able to override an unresolved exception.

130+ <body>
131+ <h1>Replenishment Exception Codes</h1>
132+ <p class="subtitle">For Warehouse Workers, Supervisors, and Salesforce Admins</p>
133+
134+ <nav>
135+ <p>On this page</p>
136+ <ul>
137+ <li><a href="#what">What it does</a></li>
138+ <li><a href="#how">How to use it</a></li>
139+ <li><a href="#setup">Setup</a></li>
140+ <li><a href="#limits">Limitations</a></li>
141+ </ul>
142+ </nav>
143+
144+ <h2 id="what">What it does</h2>
145+ <p>
146+ When a replenishment task stalls, a warehouse worker can log a structured reason instead
147+ of the delay going unexplained. Pick a code — Blocked Location, Inventory Mismatch,
148+ Equipment Constraint, Close-to-Code Diversion, Product Damage, Location Empty, or Other
149+ — add a note, and submit. Supervisors see the full exception history per task and
150+ resolve or override anything outstanding. A rollup report of where replenishment delays
151+ are coming from is tracked separately (see Limitations).
152+ </p>
153+
154+ <h2 id="how">How to use it</h2>
155+ <h3>Warehouse worker — Replenishment Worker Queue</h3>
156+ <ol>
157+ <li>
158+ On an <strong>Assigned</strong> or <strong>In Progress</strong> task card, click
159+ <strong>Log Exception</strong>. An inline panel opens with a code dropdown.
160+ </li>
161+ <li>
162+ Pick a code and add a note.
163+ <strong>Other requires a note of at least 10 characters</strong> before you can
164+ submit.
165+ </li>
166+ <li>
167+ Submit. The exception is stamped with your name, warehouse, shift, and the current
168+ time. The task card shows an open-exception count badge.
169+ </li>
170+ </ol>

187+ <p>

192+ <h3>Supervisor — Replenishment Tasks board</h3>
193+ <ol>
194+ <li>
195+ Click <strong>View exception history</strong> on any task to see every logged
196+ exception: code, note, logged-by, shift, timestamp, and resolution state.
197+ </li>
198+ <li>
199+ <strong>Resolve</strong> an exception with a resolution note — this clears it from
200+ the open count.
201+ </li>
202+ <li>
203+ <strong>Override</strong> when the cause can't be resolved but the task needs to
204+ move forward. Override requires the
205+ <strong>Override Replenishment Exception</strong> custom permission — without it,
206+ the action is rejected.
207+ </li>
208+ </ol>

212+ alt="Resolved exception history entry"
213+ />
214+ <p>
215+ A resolved exception entry in the task's exception history, with resolver and
216+ timestamp.
217+ </p>
218+ </div>
219+
220+ <h2 id="setup">Setup</h2>
221+ <ol>
222+ <li>
223+ <strong>Grant object access.</strong> Assign the
224+ <strong>Replenishment Board Access</strong> permission set to both workers and
225+ supervisors.
226+ </li>
227+ <li>
228+ <strong>Grant override access.</strong> Assign the
229+ <strong>Override Replenishment Exception</strong> custom permission, via a
230+ permission set, only to supervisors who should be able to override an unresolved
231+ exception.
232+ </li>
233+ <li>
234+ <strong>Configure exception codes.</strong> Codes live in Custom Metadata.
235+ <code>Is_Active__c</code> enables or disables a code,
236+ <code>Sort_Order__c</code> controls dropdown order,
237+ <code>Requires_Note__c</code> forces a note, and
238+ <code>Warehouse_Code__c</code> scopes a variant of a code to one warehouse. For
239+ example, to require a note for <strong>Equipment Constraint</strong> only at one
240+ warehouse, add a metadata record with that warehouse's code and
241+ <code>Requires_Note__c = true</code> — the base record stays optional everywhere
242+ else.
243+ </li>
244+ </ol>
245+
246+ <h2 id="limits">Limitations</h2>
247+ <ul>
248+ <li>
249+ <strong>No bulk aggregation or reporting UI yet.</strong> This release ships the
250+ <strong>Replenishment Exceptions</strong> report type (grouping by code, shift,
251+ warehouse, or resolved status) as the data-provider seam; the supervisor-facing
252+ report/dashboard itself is tracked under the Reporting epic (<a
253+ href="https://ohanafy.atlassian.net/browse/BMS-5906"
254+ >BMS-5906</a
255+ >).
256+ </li>
257+ <li>
258+ <strong>Overrides are gated.</strong> Only supervisors with the Override
259+ Replenishment Exception custom permission can override; everyone else is rejected.
260+ </li>
261+ <li>
262+ <strong>Not yet available:</strong> offline handheld sync, a drillable exception
263+ dashboard, and intercompany close-to-code diversion notifications.
264+ </li>
265+ </ul>
266+ </body>
267+</html>
docs/product/wms/replenishment-exception-codes/usage.md+36-0
@@ -0,0 +1,36 @@
1+# Replenishment Exception Codes — Usage & Setup
2+
3+_For warehouse workers, supervisors, and the Salesforce admins who set the feature up._
4+
5+## What it does
6+
7+Lets a warehouse worker log a structured reason — an exception code plus a note — against a replenishment task that's stalled, instead of the delay going unexplained. Supervisors see the full exception history per task and resolve or override outstanding exceptions. Rolling exception counts up into a report by code, shift, and warehouse is tracked separately under the Reporting epic (see Limitations).
8+
9+## How to use it
10+
11+### Warehouse worker — Replenishment Worker Queue
12+
13+1. On an **Assigned** or **In Progress** task card, click **Log Exception**. An inline panel opens with a code dropdown: Blocked Location, Inventory Mismatch, Equipment Constraint, Close-to-Code Diversion, Product Damage, Location Empty, or Other.
14+2. Pick a code and add a note. **Other requires a note of at least 10 characters** — enforced both in the panel and on submit, so it can't be bypassed by editing the request.
15+3. Submit. The exception is stamped with your name, the task's warehouse and shift, and the current timestamp. The task card now shows an open-exception count badge.
16+4. **You can't complete a task with unresolved exceptions.** Attempting to complete one shows: _"Cannot complete task — N unresolved exception(s) require resolution or override."_ Get a supervisor to resolve or override the exception before retrying.
17+
18+### Supervisor — Replenishment Tasks board
19+
20+1. On any task, click **View exception history** to see every logged exception in order: code, note, logged-by, shift, timestamp, and resolution state.
21+2. **Resolve** an exception by entering a resolution note. This clears it from the task's open-exception count.
22+3. **Override** an exception when the underlying cause can't be resolved but the task needs to move forward anyway. Override requires the **Override Replenishment Exception** custom permission — without it, the action is rejected. An override is recorded with `Resolution_Source__c = "Supervisor Override"` and `Resolved_By__c` set, for audit.
23+
24+## Setup
25+
26+1. **Grant object access.** Assign the **Replenishment Board Access** permission set to both workers and supervisors — it grants the new `Replenishment_Exception__c` object (`OHFY-Data-Model/force-app/main/default/objects/Replenishment_Exception__c/`).
27+2. **Grant override access.** Assign the **Override Replenishment Exception** custom permission — via a permission set — only to supervisors who should be able to override an unresolved exception. It mirrors the existing scan-override permission pattern.
28+3. **Configure exception codes.** Codes are Custom Metadata records on `Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt` (`OHFY-Data-Model/force-app/main/default/objects/Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt/`): `Is_Active__c` to enable/disable a code, `Sort_Order__c` to control dropdown order, `Requires_Note__c` to force a note for that code, and `Warehouse_Code__c` to scope a variant of a code to a single warehouse. For example, to require a note for **Equipment Constraint** only at warehouse `GULF-02`, add a metadata record with `Warehouse_Code__c = 'GULF-02'` and `Requires_Note__c = true` — the base (blank-warehouse) record stays optional everywhere else.
29+
30+Server-side logic lives in `OHFY-WMS/force-app/main/default/classes/executables/replenishment/E_ReplenishmentExceptions.cls`; the worker and supervisor UI ship in `OHFY-WMS-UI/force-app/main/default/lwc/replenishmentWorkerQueue` and `OHFY-WMS-UI/force-app/main/default/lwc/replenishmentTaskManager`.
31+
32+## Limitations
33+
34+- **No bulk exception aggregation or reporting UI yet.** This release ships the `Replenishment_Exceptions` custom report type (base object `Replenishment_Exception__c`, exposing `Exception_Code__c`, `Shift__c`, `Warehouse__c`, `Is_Resolved__c`, `Resolution_Source__c`) as the data-provider seam, but the actual supervisor-facing report/dashboard is tracked separately under the Reporting epic — see [BMS-5906](https://ohanafy.atlassian.net/browse/BMS-5906).
35+- **Overrides are gated, not open to every supervisor.** Only users with the Override Replenishment Exception custom permission can override; everyone else is rejected at submit.
36+- **Not yet available:** offline handheld sync for logging exceptions without connectivity, a drillable exception dashboard LWC, and intercompany close-to-code diversion notifications. These are descoped from this release.

1+import { runSfApex, extractDebugPayload } from "./sfCli";
2+
3+/**
4+ * Per-test seed for the BMS-3780 replenishment exception-codes Playwright specs
5+ * (`replenishmentWorkerQueue` + `replenishmentTaskManager`).
6+ *
7+ * Mints a hermetic warehouse + destination bin + item (same minimal graph as
8+ * `replenishmentSeed.ts`'s `itemGraph`, duplicated here since that helper isn't exported) and
9+ * one `Assigned` `Replenishment_Task__c` owned by the running CLI/auth user (`Assigned_Worker__c
10+ * = UserInfo.getUserId()`) so it renders under "My Tasks" in the worker queue. The item
11+ * deliberately carries no `Case_UPC__c` and the bin no `Location_Code__c`, matching
12+ * `seedBreachedBin`'s graph, so `completionHasAnchor`/`pickupHasAnchors` are false and the
13+ * scan-gate branches never engage — the exception-code flow is what's under test, not scan
14+ * enforcement.
15+ */
16+export interface ReplenishmentExceptionTaskSeed {
17+ warehouseId: string;
18+ warehouseName: string;
19+ binId: string;
20+ itemId: string;
21+ itemName: string;
22+ itemLineId: string;
23+ itemTypeId: string;
24+ taskId: string;
25+ casesRequested: number;
26+}
27+
28+export interface ReplenishmentExceptionSeed extends ReplenishmentExceptionTaskSeed {
29+ exceptionId: string;
30+}
31+
32+const taskGraph = (tag: string, casesRequested: number) => `
33+ohfy__Location__c wh = new ohfy__Location__c(
34+ Name = 'E2E Excp WH ${tag}', ohfy__Type__c = 'Warehouse', ohfy__Is_Active__c = true
35+);
36+insert wh;
37+ohfy__Location__c bin = new ohfy__Location__c(
38+ Name = 'E2E Excp Bin ${tag}', ohfy__Type__c = 'Bin',
39+ ohfy__Parent_Location__c = wh.Id, ohfy__Is_Active__c = true
40+);
41+insert bin;
42+ohfy__Item_Line__c il = new ohfy__Item_Line__c();
43+insert il;
44+ohfy__Item_Type__c it = new ohfy__Item_Type__c(ohfy__Item_Line__c = il.Id);
45+insert it;
46+ohfy__Item__c item = new ohfy__Item__c(
47+ ohfy__Item_Line__c = il.Id, ohfy__Item_Type__c = it.Id, Name = 'E2E Excp Item ${tag}',
48+ ohfy__Default_Case_Price__c = 1, ohfy__Case_Quantity__c = 1, ohfy__Type__c = 'Finished Good',
49+ ohfy__UOM__c = 'US Volume', ohfy__Packaging_Type__c = '1/2 Barrel(s)',
50+ ohfy__Last_Case_Price__c = 1, ohfy__Average_Sale_Counter__c = 1,
51+ ohfy__Average_Sale_Total__c = 1, ohfy__Average_Case_Price__c = 1,
52+ ohfy__Item_Purposes__c = 'Sell', ohfy__Units_Per_Case__c = 1
53+);
54+insert item;
55+ohfy__Replenishment_Task__c task = new ohfy__Replenishment_Task__c(
56+ ohfy__Warehouse__c = wh.Id, ohfy__Item__c = item.Id, ohfy__Destination_Location__c = bin.Id,
57+ ohfy__Status__c = 'Assigned', ohfy__Assigned_Worker__c = UserInfo.getUserId(),
58+ ohfy__Cases_Requested__c = ${casesRequested}, ohfy__Shift__c = 'E2E-${tag}'
59+);
60+insert task;
61+`;
62+
63+/**
64+ * A single Assigned task in the running user's "My Tasks" list — no exception logged yet.
65+ * Covers: worker-queue render, happy-path Log Exception, and the OTHER 10-char note gate.
66+ */
67+export function seedExceptionTask(
68+ orgAlias: string,
69+ casesRequested = 10
70+): ReplenishmentExceptionTaskSeed {
71+ const tag = `${Date.now()}`;
72+ const apex = `${taskGraph(tag, casesRequested)}
73+System.debug('TEST_PAYLOAD::' + JSON.serialize(new Map<String, Object>{
74+ 'warehouseId' => wh.Id, 'warehouseName' => wh.Name, 'binId' => bin.Id,
75+ 'itemId' => item.Id, 'itemName' => item.Name, 'taskId' => task.Id,
76+ 'itemLineId' => il.Id, 'itemTypeId' => it.Id,
77+ 'casesRequested' => ${casesRequested}
78+}));`;
79+ const seed = extractDebugPayload<ReplenishmentExceptionTaskSeed>(
80+ runSfApex(apex, orgAlias),
81+ "TEST_PAYLOAD"
82+ );
83+ if (!seed) {
84+ throw new Error("seedExceptionTask: no TEST_PAYLOAD found in the anonymous-apex debug log");
85+ }
86+ return seed;
87+}
88+
89+/**
90+ * Same Assigned task as `seedExceptionTask`, plus one already-logged, unresolved
91+ * `Replenishment_Exception__c` (code BLOCKED_LOCATION — does not require a note). Covers:
92+ * the completion gate (blocked while unresolved), and the task-manager supervisor
93+ * resolve/override flows.
94+ */
95+export function seedExceptionTaskWithOpenException(
96+ orgAlias: string,
97+ casesRequested = 10
98+): ReplenishmentExceptionSeed {
99+ const tag = `${Date.now()}`;
100+ const apex = `${taskGraph(tag, casesRequested)}
101+ohfy__Replenishment_Exception__c excp = new ohfy__Replenishment_Exception__c(
102+ ohfy__Replenishment_Task__c = task.Id, ohfy__Exception_Code__c = 'BLOCKED_LOCATION',
103+ ohfy__Warehouse__c = wh.Id, ohfy__Shift__c = 'E2E-${tag}',
104+ ohfy__Logged_By__c = UserInfo.getUserId(), ohfy__Logged_At__c = System.now(),
105+ ohfy__Is_Resolved__c = false
106+);
107+insert excp;
108+System.debug('TEST_PAYLOAD::' + JSON.serialize(new Map<String, Object>{
109+ 'warehouseId' => wh.Id, 'warehouseName' => wh.Name, 'binId' => bin.Id,
110+ 'itemId' => item.Id, 'itemName' => item.Name, 'taskId' => task.Id,
111+ 'itemLineId' => il.Id, 'itemTypeId' => it.Id,
112+ 'casesRequested' => ${casesRequested}, 'exceptionId' => excp.Id
113+}));`;
114+ const seed = extractDebugPayload<ReplenishmentExceptionSeed>(
115+ runSfApex(apex, orgAlias),
116+ "TEST_PAYLOAD"
117+ );
118+ if (!seed) {
119+ throw new Error(
120+ "seedExceptionTaskWithOpenException: no TEST_PAYLOAD found in the anonymous-apex debug log"
121+ );
122+ }
123+ return seed;
124+}

1+// @covers OHFY-WMS-UI/lwc/replenishmentWorkerQueue
2+// @covers OHFY-WMS-UI/lwc/replenishmentTaskManager
3+import { test, expect, type SfPage } from "../../fixtures/salesforce.fixture";
4+import { runSfQuery } from "../../support/sfCli";
5+import { sfConnect } from "../../support/sfConnection";
6+import {
7+ seedExceptionTask,
8+ seedExceptionTaskWithOpenException,
9+ type ReplenishmentExceptionTaskSeed,

11+
12+/**
13+ * E2E for structured replenishment exception codes (BMS-3780).
14+ *
15+ * A worker who cannot complete an assigned/in-progress task as instructed logs a structured
16+ * exception (code + optional/required note) against it via `c-replenishment-worker-queue`. The
17+ * exception is stamped with the logging user, warehouse, shift, and timestamp
18+ * (`E_ReplenishmentExceptions.logException`), and blocks `E_ReplenishmentTask.completeTask`
19+ * until a supervisor resolves or overrides it. A supervisor works the history from
20+ * `c-replenishment-task-manager`'s per-task "View exception history" panel.
21+ *
22+ * Preconditions on the target org:
23+ * 1. OHFY-WMS + OHFY-WMS-UI replenishment metadata deployed, including
24+ * Replenishment_Exception__c / Replenishment_Exception_Code__mdt (BLOCKED_LOCATION,
25+ * OTHER, …).
26+ * 2. The Replenishment_Tasks / Replenishment_Worker_Queue tabs deployed + visible.
27+ * 3. The CLI/auth user holds Legacy_Security_Bypass (SYSTEM_MODE reads/writes) but NOT
28+ * Override_Replenishment_Exception — the last scenario below asserts the denial path for
29+ * exactly that reason.
30+ *
31+ * Each test seeds its own hermetic warehouse + item + Assigned task (and, where noted, one
32+ * already-logged unresolved exception) so scenarios never interfere with each other.
33+ */
34+const ORG = process.env.SF_ORG_ALIAS || "replinish";
35+const WORKER_TAB = "Replenishment_Worker_Queue";
36+const MANAGER_TAB = "Replenishment_Tasks";
37+
38+// The Aura toast renders both a `.slds-notify` container and an inner `.toastTitle` — a
39+// `.slds-notify`-inclusive selector matches two elements (strict-mode violation). Scope to the
40+// single `.toastTitle` heading node, per the established WMS-spec pattern (BMS-4103).
41+async function expectToastTitle(sfPage: SfPage, title: string) {
42+ await expect(
43+ sfPage.locator(".toastTitle.slds-text-heading--small").filter({ hasText: title })
44+ ).toBeVisible({ timeout: 15_000 });
45+}
46+
47+// Error toasts from both LWCs' shared `toastError(e)` helper always title as "Something went
48+// wrong" and carry the actionable server message in the body (`.toastMessage`) — so error
49+// assertions must scope to the message, not the generic title.
50+async function expectToastMessage(sfPage: SfPage, text: string | RegExp) {
51+ await expect(sfPage.locator(".toastMessage").filter({ hasText: text })).toBeVisible({
52+ timeout: 15_000,
53+ });
54+}
55+
56+// Every seed minted in this file — torn down once at the end. Leaked Assigned tasks matter:
57+// getWorkerQueue's "my tasks" clause is NOT warehouse-scoped, so an undeleted Assigned task
58+// pollutes every future run's My Tasks list on this org.
59+const createdSeeds: ReplenishmentExceptionTaskSeed[] = [];
60+
61+test.afterAll(async () => {
62+ if (!createdSeeds.length) {
63+ return;
64+ }
65+ const conn = await sfConnect(ORG);
66+ const destroy = async (sobject: string, ids: string[]) => {
67+ if (ids.length) {
68+ await conn
69+ .sobject(sobject)
70+ .destroy(ids)
71+ .catch(() => undefined);
72+ }
73+ };
74+ const taskIds = createdSeeds.map(s => s.taskId);
75+ // Exceptions were also logged DURING tests — query them by task rather than trusting the
76+ // seed payloads.
77+ const exceptionIds = runSfQuery(
78+ `SELECT Id FROM ohfy__Replenishment_Exception__c WHERE ohfy__Replenishment_Task__c IN ('${taskIds.join("','")}')`,
79+ ORG
80+ ).map(r => String(r.Id));
81+ await destroy("ohfy__Replenishment_Exception__c", exceptionIds);
82+ await destroy("ohfy__Replenishment_Task__c", taskIds);
83+ await destroy(
84+ "ohfy__Item__c",
85+ createdSeeds.map(s => s.itemId)
86+ );
87+ await destroy(
88+ "ohfy__Item_Type__c",
89+ createdSeeds.map(s => s.itemTypeId)
90+ );
91+ await destroy(
92+ "ohfy__Item_Line__c",
93+ createdSeeds.map(s => s.itemLineId)
94+ );
95+ await destroy(
96+ "ohfy__Location__c",
97+ createdSeeds.map(s => s.binId)
98+ );
99+ await destroy(
100+ "ohfy__Location__c",
101+ createdSeeds.map(s => s.warehouseId)
102+ );
103+});
104+
105+// The seeded task's "My Tasks" card. `getWorkerQueue`'s assigned-tasks clause filters by
106+// worker ONLY (not warehouse), so stale Assigned/In-Progress tasks from earlier runs leak into
107+// the list regardless of the selected warehouse — `.first()` is never safe here. The seeded
108+// item name is timestamp-unique and stays visible in the card header through every panel swap
109+// (exception form, completion form), so it is the stable per-test anchor.
110+function myTaskCard(sfPage: SfPage, itemName: string) {
111+ return sfPage.getByTestId("my-task-card").filter({ hasText: itemName });

338+ await expect(async () => {
